title: The agentic web is here
script:
In two thousand one, Tim Berners-Lee published a vision for the Semantic Web in Scientific American.
He designed an internet navigated by autonomous software agents to address our every need.
Now, Artificial Intelligence is finally making that twenty-five-year-old prediction a reality across the internet.
Instead of humans clicking links, AI agents will handle entire multi-step workflows across different websites.
This shift replaces manual browsing with autonomous systems executing complex online tasks for users.
Would you let an AI agent book your next vacation entirely on its own?
